About

I'm a Research Fellow at SPAR and an Undergraduate Researcher at the Governance and Responsible AI Lab (GRAIL) / Purdue AI Forge. I'm pursuing a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence with a minor in Mathematics at Purdue University.

My research spans mechanistic interpretability, diffusion language models, AI safety, and technical AI governance. Recent work examines policy auditing with internal model evidence, SAE feature evolution during denoising, and prompt injection in retrieval-augmented generation.

InterestsMechanistic interpretabilityDiffusion language modelsAI safetyTechnical AI governance

Projects

Denoising Trajectories for Diffusion Language Model Control ↗

AI Control Hackathon, Apart Research / Redwood Research · Mar. 2026. Built SAE-based monitoring and steering for LLaDA-8B-Instruct. Attacks were detected at mean denoising step 9.60 versus 63.00 for output checks; steering gains remained preliminary.

Prompt Injection and Mechanistic Analysis in RAG ↗

CS 390, Purdue University · Feb. 2026. Evaluated BM25 RAG attacks on HotpotQA for Qwen2.5 0.5B and Gemma 2 2B, using attention analysis, probing, activation patching, and sparse features to localize attack effects and compare defenses.

Prompting and Retrieval Evaluation ↗

CS 390, Purdue University · Jan. 2026 - Mar. 2026. Evaluated Llama 3.1 8B Instruct on 1,110 HotpotQA examples. Wikipedia retrieval reached 43.65 F1 versus 28.34 for BM25 demonstration retrieval at the best tested settings.
